tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The navy of the logo. Brand moments only: logo grounds, hero bands, social art. Not a UI surface in the light theme.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: The cyan of the logo ring, 'bit' and the pulse line. Logo, illustrations and the pulse motif only; for UI fills use `signal`.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, nav bar, plan cards.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Inset surfaces: inputs, table header rows, hover on rows.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item and info-banner ground. Pairs with `ink` text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes (3:1 on surface-000/100/200).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface-000, surface-100, surface-200 and signal-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table cells, captions. On surface-000/100/200.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, helper text. On surface-000/100 (and 200 in dark).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Primary action fills, the pulse line, progress and selected indicators. Text on it is `on-signal`.

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of `signal` fills.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `signal` and `signal-hover` fills.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Links and accent text (speeds, inline highlights) on surface-000/100/200.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px gap in the page colour. ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: status-up
tokens.usage: Operational / online. Always paired with a label and the up-dot or check icon.

tokens.name: status-degraded
tokens.usage: Degraded performance / partial. Always paired with a label and the triangle icon.

tokens.name: status-down
tokens.usage: Outage / offline / errors and destructive actions. Always paired with a label and the cross icon.

tokens.name: status-maint
tokens.usage: Scheduled maintenance / informational. Always paired with a label and the wrench or clock icon.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on a solid status fill (status-up/degraded/down/maint as a button or chip fill).

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill; alias of status-down. Text on it is `on-status`.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One hero headline per page. Poppins, sentence case.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in the customer portal.

styles.name: h3

styles.name: label

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, table cells, secondary lines.

styles.name: overline

styles.name: metric

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Ticket IDs, IP and MAC addresses, serials, timestamps, command output.

tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, status dot gap.

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding on mobile; gaps between form fields; row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gutters in grids.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections in the portal.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding (desktop).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, checkboxes, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alert banners, metric tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, plan cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the status dot only.

shadow.note: Dark theme leans on surface steps, not shadows; light theme uses one soft navy-tinted elevation.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards and plan cards at rest.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, a featured plan card.

tokens.usage: The pulse line divider and chart lines.
